title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
title_zh: 编码智能体能否在不遗忘的情况下持续演化？

paragraphs.en: 实证研究表明编程智能体框架跨任务持续演化会遭遇灾难性遗忘，性能大幅下降。 Recently, harness self-evolution has emerged as an important paradigm for improving agent performance. Prior studies show that evolving the agent harness can effectively enhance agent capabilities without modifying the foundation model's parameters. We find that existing approaches largely study agent evolution on a single task. In practice, coding agents may need to handle multiple task types over time. Whether an agent harness can continuously evolve across multiple tasks without suffering from catastrophic forgetting remains an important open question. In this paper, we investigate this open question through a comprehensive empirical study of continual harness self-evolution. We organize three software engineering task datasets into six different evolution directions and apply two representative harness evolution methods to perform continual evolution along these directions. Our experimental results show that evolution on a subsequent dataset can substantially undermine the performance on previously seen datasets. For example, with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, Meta-Harness improves its performance on SWE-Bench to 94.0% after evolution. However, after further evolution on FeatureBench, its performance on SWE-Bench drops to 32.0% by the fifth round, corresponding to a 66% relative decrease. Finally, based on our experimental findings, we identify several insights, providing directions for the continual self-evolution of agent harnesses. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-Agent/continual-harness-evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究表明，编程智能体框架在跨任务持续演化过程中会遭遇灾难性遗忘，性能大幅下降。最近，框架自演化已成为提升智能体性能的一种重要范式。 已有研究表明，在不修改基础模型参数的情况下，对智能体框架进行演化可以有效增强智能体的能力。 我们发现，现有方法大多在单一任务上研究智能体的演化。 在实践中，编程智能体可能需要随时间推移处理多种任务类型。 智能体框架能否在多个任务上持续演化而不遭受灾难性遗忘，仍然是一个重要的开放性问题。 本文通过对框架持续自演化进行的全面实证研究来探究这一开放性问题。 我们将三个软件工程任务数据集组织成六个不同的演化方向，并应用两种具有代表性的框架演化方法沿这些方向执行持续演化。 我们的实验结果表明，在后续数据集上的演化会显著损害模型在先前数据集上的性能。 例如，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731，Meta-Harness 在演化后其在 SWE-Bench 上的性能提升至 94.0%。 然而，在 FeatureBench 上进一步演化后，到第五轮时其在 SWE-Bench 上的性能下降至 32.0%，相当于相对下降 66%。 最后，基于我们的实验发现，我们总结出若干洞见，为智能体框架的持续自演化提供了方向。 代码已发布于 https://github.com/THU-Agent/continual-harness-evolution。
